title: Improve a professional LinkedIn headline
description: Draft several concise headlines that communicate actual work and intended audience.
accomplishes: Draft several concise headlines that communicate actual work and intended audience. Explain tone and trade-offs. Use only supported expertise and avoid fabricated credentials, inflated seniority or claims that a headline guarantees visibility or enquiries.
prompt:
Act as a career writing adviser.

Task: Improve a professional LinkedIn headline.

Input context:
- REAL ROLE: [REAL ROLE]
- EXPERTISE: [EXPERTISE]
- AUDIENCE: [AUDIENCE]
- EVIDENCE: [EVIDENCE]

Draft several concise headlines that communicate actual work and intended audience. Explain tone and trade-offs. Use only supported expertise and avoid fabricated credentials, inflated seniority or claims that a headline guarantees visibility or enquiries.

Make the output practical, reviewable and appropriate to the supplied context.

Use English for explanations unless the task or user explicitly requires another language. Use clear sections and a format suited to the deliverable. If essential information is missing, ask a focused question before concluding. Label assumptions and unknowns. Do not invent facts, sources, results or completed checks. End with verification criteria and remaining limitations.
exampleResult:
## Headline direction
“Digital marketing and AI automation | Practical workflows for service businesses” describes a field and audience without inventing awards or outcomes. An alternative can emphasise a specific verified service. Check that every phrase matches real experience before publication. These are editable positioning drafts, not profile changes or evidence of increased reach.
